decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX builds on an established trommel screen with a positive market reception, so it meets aspirations in a core mobile screening segment at low added cost.
The AK flail shredder line is a long-standing core range that was updated to EU Stage V and showcased at trade fairs, which signals satisfactory performance and continued investment.
The mobile high-speed grinder fits the firm's core mobile recycling business and gained its own website page in 2019, so there is no clear shortfall to trigger dropping it.

The CERON pre-shredder generation shows customer installations and claims of setting standards, but stationary plants are further from the mobile core and slack after restructuring is limited, so the risk of a cut is somewhat higher.
